diagnosis: The selected issue genuinely reproduces and the candidate genuinely fixes it. At the clean base_commit plain ConditionSet.subs produced ConditionSet(1/3, Contains(1/3, ImageSet(...)), ImageSet(...)) -- exactly the malformed over-substitution reported publicly (the ConditionSet bound dummy x was replaced by 1/3) -- and after the candidate it correctly became ImageSet(Lambda(n, 2*pi*n + asin(1/3)), Integers). The first hand-written probe was a faulty INSTRUMENT: its assertions only checked for a free symbol y and for a collapse to the singleton {1/3}, neither of which distinguishes ConditionSet(1/3, ...) from the correct result, so it exited 0 at baseline. This was a probe-authoring defect, NOT a non-evaluable issue and NOT a reason to replace the issue.
evidence_basis_for_revision: The strengthened assertions use ONLY the public issue report: (a) a surviving ConditionSet's first argument (the bound dummy) must remain a Symbol, rejecting the observed ConditionSet(1/3, ...); and (b) plain .subs must equal the report's own reference results via xreplace and simultaneous=True, which the report explicitly shows were already correct at baseline. The maintainer test_patch was never read when authoring or revising the probe.
action: Replaced the weak probe with the strengthened symptom probe and re-ran the probe-flip gate over all 8 issues. All 8 then flipped (baseline exit!=0, post-candidate exit==0). The original failure record is retained unchanged; the issue was kept, not substituted.
